steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In April 2024, Equity Mates said Amgen had a once-per-month injectable called maritide that delivered 15% weight loss after 85 days in trials, showing its push into obesity treatment.

episode.title: Lump sum or DCA, the latest on Ozempic & a baby Berkshire?

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In April 2024, Equity Mates described the obesity drug market as a race for market share, with Amgen’s maritide showing similar results to rivals, so competition would shape whether it sustained strong profits.
